svg.font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.text: (a) Random row split: every specimen falls on both sides, which leaks
(b) Group split: each specimen is wholly training or wholly validation
(c) Forward-chaining time split: each validation block follows its training rows after a gap
(d) Both: validation specimens held out entirely, and later than the training period
one row per measurement; the letter is the specimen
